metaDescription: Fleet managers and owner-operators: find the right phone mount for your F-Series, Silverado, Sierra, Ram, Transit, Sprinter, or ProMaster. Cup holder,
excerpt: Every work truck cab is different. This guide maps F-Series, Silverado, Ram, Transit, Sprinter, and ProMaster layouts to the right phone mount approach, including cup holder, suction, and AMPS drill-base setups, so fleet managers and owner-operators can stop guessing and start mounting.

spec.title: Phone Mounts for Popular Work Trucks
spec.audience: fleet managers and owner-operators running F-Series, Silverado, Sierra, Ram, Transit, Sprinter, and ProMaster vehicles
spec.problem: The most common work trucks and vans have different cab layouts, console shapes, dash materials, cup-holder positions, and upfit rules.
spec.angle: Map popular work truck model families to mount approaches, including where no-drill, cup-holder, wedge, suction, and AMPS drill-base setups make sense.
spec.comparisonFrame: Mention that vehicle-specific mounts are strong when every truck is the same model year. Universal AMPS and cup-holder/wedge systems are better when the fleet includes pickups, vans, and service trucks from multiple brands. Avoid declaring one product type best for every model.

Equipped with a vibration-resistant dual ball joint system and industry-standard AMPS drill base, the mount ensures your device remains securely positioned even under harsh conditions. Universal compatibility accommodates most smartphones, including those with protective cases, featuring adjustable feet and a precise 4-hole AMPS pattern for reliable attachment. Designed for professional use, it provides full 360 degree rotation and tilt via dual pivot points for optimal ergonomic viewing angles. products.title: iBOLT™ xProDock™ NFC BizMount™ Suction Cup
products.description: The xProDock Bizmount™ with an 80mm sticky suction cup is a heavy-duty smartphone mount built for rugged trucking, fleet, and industrial use. It securely attaches to smooth surfaces like dashboards, desks, and carts, offering multi-angle adjustability for optimal viewing. The reusable sticky suction cup provides strong grip without adhesives and restores suction by rinsing and air drying. Dual ball joints ensure vibration-resistant stability on rough roads. Compatible with most smartphones (2.59" to 3.7" wide) and cases, it features a spring-loaded top latch and a 3.75" pedestal with standard 1-inch (25mm) AMPS ball joints. Easy one-handed operation, 360 degree rotation, and tilt offer ergonomic positioning. Includes a 2-meter microUSB charging cable and an 80mm dash disc for mounting on textured surfaces. products.title: iBOLT™ xProDock™ Bizmount™ Console- Phone Cup Holder Mount
products.description: The xProDock Bizmount™ Console with an expandable cup holder base is a heavy-duty smartphone mount designed for trucks, fleet vehicles, commercial drivers, and industrial use. Its adjustable base fits securely into cup holders from 2.5" to 3.5" diameter, providing a stable and vibration-resistant phone mounting solution. Featuring dual ball joints for 360-degree rotation and tilt, this truck phone mount allows for customizable, ergonomic viewing angles on the road. Compatible with most smartphones and protective cases, the spring-loaded top latch accommodates devices 2.59" to 3.7" wide. This rugged cup holder phone mount kit includes everything needed for quick, tool-free installation, making it ideal for Electronic Logging Device (ELD) compliance, fleet management, and hands-free smartphone use during long hauls.
